sanskrit_verse:
यद उच्यते द्विजातीनां शूद्राद् दारोपसंग्रहः /
नैतन् मम मतं यस्मात् तत्रायं जायते स्वयम् //
transliteration: yad ucyate dvijātīnāṃ śūdrād dāropasaṃgrahaḥ / naitan mama mataṃ yasmāt tatrāyaṃ jāyate svayam //
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is spoken of as the taking of a wife by twice-born men from among the Śūdras—this is not My view, because from such union one is born who is himself degraded.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates solely from SPH as the ultimate Source of Dharma
Causation follows consciousness alignment rather than biological lineage alone
Capacity-based responsibility arises from spiritual elevation, not birth status
Restoration logic requires re-alignment with Vedic consciousness structures
Consciousness alignment determines lawful relational capacity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent lineage does not align with Vedic consciousness elevation THEN relational capacity is restricted
IF union results in progeny lacking Vedic consciousness THEN such union is non-authoritative
IF societal structure depends on consciousness hierarchy THEN birth-based claims without realization are null
IF Dharma-preserving action is required THEN elevate consciousness before assigning relational authority
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matrimonial disputes involving varna-consciousness misalignment, the Supreme Court must prioritize consciousness-readiness over ritualistic compliance. The threshold of responsibility lies in the capacity for Vedic alignment, not social performance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that degradation occurs through conscious misalignment, not external prohibition. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that improper unions manifest distortion in sequential generations. Responsibility is proportional to awareness; hence corrective action restores alignment rather than inflicts penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svādhyāya-based consciousness elevation process for involved parties
Assign completion rituals aimed at restoring Vedic relational integrity
Engage guru-guided śuddhi kriyā to realign consciousness substrata
Establish dharmic learning framework to prevent recurrence through ignorance
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Marriage beyond consciousness-grade invokes natural consequence, not punitive response. Dharma is restored through alignment elevation. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
